title: Long-Service Addition to the Chronic-Outage Credit — Questions Answered for Electric Service Agreement Desk Staff
content:
These questions answered cover the tenure add-on to the chronic-outage credit on an **Electric Service Agreement**.

> **Rule.** A tenure add-on is added to the chronic-outage credit: 0.8 times the schedule's chronic outage credit amount for an agreement in service 120 whole calendar months or more since its start date, 0.5 times that amount for one in service at least 60 but fewer than 120 months, and nothing for one in service fewer than 60 months.

**What is the add-on figured on?**
On the schedule's chronic outage credit amount as the schedule states it.

**How is length of service measured?**
In whole calendar months from the agreement's start date to the posting date. An agreement that completes its 120th whole calendar month on the posting date takes 0.8 times the amount; on the day before, with 119 whole months, it takes 0.5 times. One that completes its 60th whole calendar month on the posting date takes 0.5 times; on the day before, with 59 whole months, there is no add-on.

**Where does the add-on enter the credit?**
It is added last, to the credit as already rounded to the cent, and the total is rounded to the cent.

**Is the add-on ever posted by itself?**
No. It is added to a chronic-outage credit; it is not a separate credit.

**Hypothetical figures.** Schedule chronic outage credit amount $30.00; credit before the add-on $37.50.

| Whole calendar months in service | Add-on | Credit with the add-on |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | $24.00 | $61.50 |
| 60 to 119 | $15.00 | $52.50 |
| fewer than 60 | nothing | $37.50 |
